_comment: GES DISC alerts copied from 02-platforms-and-apis.md (verified 2026-11-14). Update when GES DISC posts changes. 'outage_giovanni_prefixes' makes the router skip Giovanni for those variable IDs and use the fallback.

alerts.message: Outage of some cloud Giovanni variables: AIRS3STD 7.0, GLDAS_NOAH025_3H 2.1, IMERG DE/DL/HHE/HHL, OMI daily products, and others.
Ocean grid cells are masked for land-model variables (GLDAS, NLDAS). Choose land regions for these variables.
A spurious-zeros bug before 2024-01-01 in GLDAS 3H, MERRA-2 and NLDAS series was fixed on 2026-03-26. Cached data retrieved before that date should be refreshed.
